017package org.apache.juneau.http.header;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022import java.util.function.*;
023
024/**
025 * Represents an HTTP <c>WWW-Authenticate</c> header.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * Indicates the authentication scheme that should be used to access the requested entity.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack.
032 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
033 * (and possibly earlier).
034 *
035 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
036 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * @since 9.2.1
040 */
041@SuppressWarnings({
042   "java:S1192" // Duplicated "value" literals are HTTP header component keys; a constant would obscure the header grammar.
043})
044public class WwwAuthenticate extends HttpStringHeader {
045
046   /** The header name */
047   public static final String NAME = "WWW-Authenticate";
048
049   /**
050    * Constructor with an eager value.
051    *
052    * @param value The header value. May be <jk>null</jk>.
053    */
054   public WwwAuthenticate(String value) {
055      super(NAME, value);
056   }
057
058   /**
059    * Constructor with a lazy value supplier.
060    *
061    * @param valueSupplier Supplier for the header value. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
062    */
063   public WwwAuthenticate(Supplier<String> valueSupplier) {
064      super(NAME, valueSupplier);
065   }
066
067   /**
068    * Static factory method with an eager value.
069    *
070    * @param value The header value. May be <jk>null</jk>.
071    * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
072    */
073   public static WwwAuthenticate of(String value) {
074      return new WwwAuthenticate(value);
075   }
076
077   /**
078    * Static factory method with a lazy value supplier.
079    *
080    * @param valueSupplier Supplier for the header value. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
081    * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
082    */
083   public static WwwAuthenticate of(Supplier<String> valueSupplier) {
084      return new WwwAuthenticate(valueSupplier);
085   }
086
087   /**
088    * Creates a new empty {@link Builder}.
089    *
090    * @return A new builder. Never <jk>null</jk>.
091    */
092   public static Builder create() {
093      return new Builder();
094   }
095
096   /**
097    * Creates a {@link Builder} pre-populated with a <c>Basic</c> challenge for the given realm.
098    *
099    * @param realm The protection space realm. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
100    * @return A new builder. Never <jk>null</jk>.
101    */
102   public static Builder basic(String realm) {
103      return create().basic(realm);
104   }
105
106   /**
107    * Creates a {@link Builder} pre-populated with a <c>Bearer</c> challenge.
108    *
109    * @return A new builder. Never <jk>null</jk>.
110    */
111   public static Builder bearer() {
112      return create().bearer();
113   }
114
115   /**
116    * Creates a {@link Builder} pre-populated with a <c>Digest</c> challenge.
117    *
118    * @return A new builder. Never <jk>null</jk>.
119    */
120   public static Builder digest() {
121      return create().digest();
122   }
123
124   //------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
125   // Inner types
126   //------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
127
128   /**
129    * Fluent builder for assembling an HTTP <c>WWW-Authenticate</c> challenge value.
130    *
131    * <p>
132    * Composes the <c>scheme [ 1*SP #auth-param ]</c> challenge form defined by
133    * <a class='doclink' href='https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7235#section-4.1'>RFC 7235 §4.1</a>.  Typed setters
134    * cover the common Basic / Bearer / Digest auth-params and apply the correct quoting (quoted-string vs token);
135    * {@link #param(String, String)} is a generic escape hatch so new params never require an API change.  The scheme
136    * presets ({@link #basic(String)} / {@link #bearer()} / {@link #digest()}) overwrite the scheme; auth-param setters
137    * overwrite a previously-set param of the same name while preserving its original position.
138    *
139    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
140    * <p class='bjava'>
141    *    String <jv>value</jv> = WwwAuthenticate.<jsm>create</jsm>()
142    *       .digest()
143    *       .realm(<js>"http-auth@example.org"</js>)
144    *       .qop(<js>"auth"</js>, <js>"auth-int"</js>)
145    *       .nonce(<js>"7ypf/xlj9XXwfDPEoM4URrv/xwf94BcCAzFZH4GiTo0v"</js>)
146    *       .algorithm(<js>"SHA-256"</js>)
147    *       .build();
148    *    <jc>// =&gt; "Digest realm=\"http-auth@example.org\", qop=\"auth,auth-int\", nonce=\"...\", algorithm=SHA-256"</jc>
149    * </p>
150    *
151    * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
152    *    <li class='jc'>{@link WwwAuthenticate}
153    *    <li class='extlink'><a class='doclink' href='https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7235'>RFC 7235 - HTTP/1.1 Authentication</a>
154    * </ul>
155    *
156    * @since 10.0.0
157    */
158   public static class Builder {
159
160      private String scheme;
161      private final Map<String,String> params = m();
162
163      /**
164       * Sets the authentication scheme (e.g. <js>"Basic"</js>, <js>"Bearer"</js>, <js>"Digest"</js>).
165       *
166       * @param value The scheme name. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
167       * @return This object.
168       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
169       */
170      public Builder scheme(String value) {
171         reqnn("value", value);
172         var v = value.trim();
173         if (v.isEmpty())
174            throw iaex("scheme must not be blank");
175         scheme = v;
176         return this;
177      }
178
179      /**
180       * Sets the scheme to <c>Basic</c> and the <c>realm</c> auth-param.
181       *
182       * @param realm The protection space realm. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
183       * @return This object.
184       */
185      public Builder basic(String realm) {
186         return scheme("Basic").realm(realm);
187      }
188
189      /**
190       * Sets the scheme to <c>Bearer</c>.
191       *
192       * @return This object.
193       */
194      public Builder bearer() {
195         return scheme("Bearer");
196      }
197
198      /**
199       * Sets the scheme to <c>Digest</c>.
200       *
201       * @return This object.
202       */
203      public Builder digest() {
204         return scheme("Digest");
205      }
206
207      /**
208       * Sets the <c>realm</c> auth-param (rendered as a quoted-string).
209       *
210       * @param value The realm value. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
211       * @return This object.
212       */
213      public Builder realm(String value) {
214         return quotedParam("realm", value);
215      }
216
217      /**
218       * Sets the <c>charset</c> auth-param (rendered as a quoted-string).
219       *
220       * @param value The charset (e.g. <js>"UTF-8"</js>). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
221       * @return This object.
222       */
223      public Builder charset(String value) {
224         return quotedParam("charset", value);
225      }
226
227      /**
228       * Sets the <c>qop</c> auth-param to a comma-separated, quoted list of quality-of-protection tokens.
229       *
230       * @param values The qop tokens (e.g. <js>"auth"</js>, <js>"auth-int"</js>). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
231       * @return This object.
232       */
233      public Builder qop(String...values) {
234         reqnn("values", values);
235         return quotedParam("qop", String.join(",", values));
236      }
237
238      /**
239       * Sets the <c>nonce</c> auth-param (rendered as a quoted-string).
240       *
241       * @param value The server nonce. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
242       * @return This object.
243       */
244      public Builder nonce(String value) {
245         return quotedParam("nonce", value);
246      }
247
248      /**
249       * Sets the <c>opaque</c> auth-param (rendered as a quoted-string).
250       *
251       * @param value The opaque value to be echoed back by the client. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
252       * @return This object.
253       */
254      public Builder opaque(String value) {
255         return quotedParam("opaque", value);
256      }
257
258      /**
259       * Sets the <c>algorithm</c> auth-param (rendered as a bare token, unquoted).
260       *
261       * @param value The algorithm (e.g. <js>"MD5"</js>, <js>"SHA-256"</js>). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
262       * @return This object.
263       */
264      public Builder algorithm(String value) {
265         return tokenParam("algorithm", value);
266      }
267
268      /**
269       * Sets the <c>domain</c> auth-param to a space-separated, quoted list of URIs.
270       *
271       * @param values The protection space URIs. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
272       * @return This object.
273       */
274      public Builder domain(String...values) {
275         reqnn("values", values);
276         return quotedParam("domain", String.join(" ", values));
277      }
278
279      /**
280       * Sets the <c>stale</c> auth-param (rendered as a bare token, unquoted).
281       *
282       * @param value <jk>true</jk> if the previous request's nonce was stale.
283       * @return This object.
284       */
285      public Builder stale(boolean value) {
286         return tokenParam("stale", Boolean.toString(value));
287      }
288
289      /**
290       * Sets the <c>error</c> auth-param (rendered as a quoted-string; RFC 6750 Bearer).
291       *
292       * @param value The error code (e.g. <js>"invalid_token"</js>). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
293       * @return This object.
294       */
295      public Builder error(String value) {
296         return quotedParam("error", value);
297      }
298
299      /**
300       * Sets the <c>error_description</c> auth-param (rendered as a quoted-string; RFC 6750 Bearer).
301       *
302       * @param value The human-readable error description. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
303       * @return This object.
304       */
305      public Builder errorDescription(String value) {
306         return quotedParam("error_description", value);
307      }
308
309      /**
310       * Generic escape hatch for setting any auth-param by name, rendered as a quoted-string.
311       *
312       * <p>
313       * Replaces any previously-registered value for the same param while preserving its original position.
314       *
315       * @param name The auth-param name. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
316       * @param value The auth-param value (quoted automatically). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
317       * @return This object.
318       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code name} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
319       */
320      public Builder param(String name, String value) {
321         return quotedParam(name, value);
322      }
323
324      private Builder quotedParam(String name, String value) {
325         reqnn("value", value);
326         params.put(cleanName(name), q(value));
327         return this;
328      }
329
330      private Builder tokenParam(String name, String value) {
331         reqnn("value", value);
332         params.put(cleanName(name), value);
333         return this;
334      }
335
336      private static String cleanName(String name) {
337         reqnn("name", name);
338         var n = name.trim();
339         if (n.isEmpty())
340            throw iaex("auth-param name must not be blank");
341         return n;
342      }
343
344      private static String q(String value) {
345         var sb = new StringBuilder(value.length() + 2);
346         sb.append('"');
347         for (var i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
348            var c = value.charAt(i);
349            if (c == '\\' || c == '"')
350               sb.append('\\');
351            sb.append(c);
352         }
353         sb.append('"');
354         return sb.toString();
355      }
356
357      /**
358       * Builds the rendered <c>WWW-Authenticate</c> challenge value.
359       *
360       * <p>
361       * Returns an empty string when no scheme or params have been registered.
362       *
363       * @return The header value. Never <jk>null</jk>.
364       */
365      public String build() {
366         if (scheme == null && params.isEmpty())
367            return "";
368         var sb = new StringBuilder();
369         if (scheme != null)
370            sb.append(scheme);
371         if (! params.isEmpty()) {
372            if (scheme != null)
373               sb.append(' ');
374            var parts = new ArrayList<String>(params.size());
375            params.forEach((k, v) -> parts.add(k + "=" + v));
376            sb.append(String.join(", ", parts));
377         }
378         return sb.toString();
379      }
380
381      /**
382       * Builds a {@link WwwAuthenticate} header bean directly from this builder.
383       *
384       * @return A {@link WwwAuthenticate} carrying {@link #build()}. Never <jk>null</jk>.
385       */
386      public WwwAuthenticate toHeader() {
387         return WwwAuthenticate.of(build());
388      }
389
390      @Override
391      public String toString() {
392         return build();
393      }
394   }
395}
